<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. The spectrum will show signals corresponding to methyl protons (typically singlets, doublets, etc.) and their integration values. By analyzing the integration of the methyl region (around 0.8–1.5 ppm) and counting distinct methyl signals, I can infer the total number of CH₃ groups in the molecule.</thought>
